answer: If you requested multiple password reset emails, only the latest reset link remains valid—use the most recent link you received. The reset link works for 15 minutes from when it was issued.

When your client exceeds the API rate limit, the API returns HTTP 429. Your client should implement exponential backoff and retry with jitter.
No—webhook events are delivered at least once, so duplicate deliveries are possible. Consumers should handle this by verifying signatures, storing event IDs, and processing events idempotently.
